kai: Quick brain-dump: thinking about a 'delta-stream' loader that optimizes for incremental checkpoint deltas + progressive verification for public streams. Idea is to avoid full-index dependency and still get good warmup predictability.
alyssa: Ooh. How does "delta" differ from our current shard/manifest approach?
kai: Two parts: 1) chunk-striping: each shard is logically divided into N stripes with tiny per-stripe digests for quick accept/reject; 2) delta-layered manifests: base manifest + optional delta overlays that only list changed stripes. Loader applies overlays atomically.
ram: So overlays let us hotpatch small changes without reuploading whole shard. How do we ensure atomicity if overlay arrives mid-prefetch?
marie: We can use manifest_version + apply-point. Loader will pin the manifest_version when a model is pinned for activation; overlays get staged under a new version and a CAS switch flips pointer. If prefetch sees mixed versions, it aborts and retries against the pinned version.
ishaan: For verification, I propose progressive verification: cheap 64-bit LRU fingerprint check during streaming, full SHA256 or signature verification done async after mapping. If full verify fails we mark stripes as corrupt and evict.
jordan: What about bandwidth-constrained regions? Progressive verification might add overhead. Could we defer full verify until stripe is about to be used by runtime?
kai: Exactly. We can prioritize full verification by runtime usage: stripes that are never touched stay as soft-verified. If runtime touches an unverified stripe we block the first access on a fast verify path (local hash) and continue with async sig check.
ram: Sounds risky for strict-regs customers. Need a mode for strict_consistency that requires full-verify before mapping.
marie: Agreed. Config flag: verify_mode: eager|progressive|strict. Default progressive for public/dedicated, strict for Private.
alyssa: How do overlays interact with quantization and on-the-fly transforms? If delta changes byte layout, we need to re-run quantize-on-read or remap semantics.
ishaan: Idea: store a transform ABI in stripe metadata: transform=none|quantize-v2|fuse-kernel. Loader will advertise the transform; runtime can request transformed view. For hotpatch overlays we embed a reverse-delta so old transforms still map.
jordan: Nice. What about mmap vs staged upload? If stripe is small, mmap+direct-dma works. For fused/quantized stripes we might want staged pinned upload. We should expose a stripe_hint: mmap|pin_upload|async_stage.
kai: We'll implement stripes as independent units for memory accounting. Backpressure uses a stripe_token_pool and max_pending_stripes. That lets prefetch stop allocating more stripes when memory high.
marie: Eviction strategy suggestion: tiered eviction: soft-evict (unmap but keep in file cache), hard-evict (release slab), and rollback (if overlay corrupted revert to previous manifest_version). All emitted as events for runbooks.
ram: Metrics to add: stripe_acquire_latency, stripe_verify_mode_breaks, overlay_apply_failures, progressive_verify_block_count. Also circuit breaker when verify_failures exceed threshold.
alyssa: Runtime API proposal: high-level ModelLoader.open_model(manifest_ref) returning ModelHandle and low-level ModelHandle.open_stripe(stripe_id) returning StripeStream with methods: read_slice, pin_to_gpu, verify_sync. Also add ModelHandle.snapshot_epoch() so caller can assert no hotpatch inside critical region.
ishaan: Testing: generate synthetic base+overlay sets, inject random stripe corruption, measure mean time to detect in progressive vs strict modes. Also test race where overlay appears mid-prefetch.
jordan: Rollout: start with dedicated internal canary, monitor overlay_apply_failures and progressive_verify_block_count for 7 days, then opt-in open beta for specific public models.
devbot: CI: created job delta-loader/integration-tests (12m queue).
kai: Action items: 1) kai: prototype stripe manifest + token-pool by Thu; 2) ishaan: verifier microbench + perf delta by Fri; 3) alyssa: add unit tests for snapshot_epoch semantics by Mon; 4) ram: wire metrics to console and add alert thresholds; 5) marie: draft rollback runbook and incident playbook.
marie: Also add docs section describing verify_mode tradeoffs and a checklist for customers migrating to overlays.
kai: Cool. I'll push a branch delta/stripe-proto and link PR here when ready. Ping me for pairing on the verifier.
devbot: Branch pushed: delta/stripe-proto (WIP).
alyssa: Thanks all. Short and pragmatic thread.
marie: :thumbsup:
